page_title: SHU 3-3 FUL | Sheffield Utd v Fulham 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+15' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd). Tim Robinson saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Fulham will take a free kick near the side line.
90+13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
90+12' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90+12' Willian (Fulham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+10' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+10' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' 3 - 3 What a goal that is! Adama Traore sends a brilliant cross into the box and Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 3:3.
90+2' The referee awards a corner and Willian (Fulham) goes over to take it.
90+2' Adama Traore (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
90+1' Fulham have a corner.
90' 14 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Oliver McBurnie will be replaced by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd).
86' 3 - 2 Goal! Tom Cairney plays a short, square pass into the path of Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 3:2. Fabulous goal!
85' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Timothy Castagne will be replaced by Kenny Tete (Fulham).
85' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ollie Arblaster.
85' Substitution. Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) in, Vini Souza out.
85' It will be a substitution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is ready to enter the pitch as Tosin Adarabioyo walks off.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is coming onto the pitch as Andreas Pereira cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Celebrations are cut short for Sheffield Utd as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
83' The Sheffield Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
82' Goal! Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:1.
81' Tim Robinson blows for a foul after Adama Traore (Fulham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Free kick. Sheffield Utd will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
79' The attendance for today's match is 30010.
77' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
76' The foul by Joao Palhinha (Fulham) was seen by Tim Robinson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Sheffield Utd win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
76' The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Alex Iwobi and he is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
73' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared to safety by the defence.

70' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) makes it 3:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Gustavo Hamer and planted his close-range header into the right side of the goal. Bernd Leno was helpless.
68' 2 - 1 Goal! Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) scores after an assist by Ben Brereton Diaz that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:1.
67' Willian (Fulham) tries to find Antonee Robinson, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
66' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
63' The substitution is prepared. Adama Traore (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sasa Lukic.
62' 1 - 1 The score has changed – 1:1. Andreas Pereira sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Joao Palhinha (Fulham) jumps highest and plants a header inside the left post.
62' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the corner kick.
61' Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.

58' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Oliver McBurnie plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
56' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Now Fulham have a corner.
55' A player from Fulham commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Sheffield Utd.
55' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
55' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
52' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
50' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
48' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
47' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

47' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.
47' The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Sheffield Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
45' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
44' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham get a free kick.
40' Dangerous play by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd). Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham have a free kick.
38' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar.
38' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.
38' Willian (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

31' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. It's a free kick to Sheffield Utd, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
27' Tim Robinson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Timothy Castagne (Fulham). Sheffield Utd are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

23' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to Sheffield Utd, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
18' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Timothy Castagne, but Ivo Grbic displays great awareness to stop him.
16' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Sheffield Utd win a free kick.
15' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
14' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
14' Willian (Fulham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
9' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Fulham.
8' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Ivo Grbic.
7' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) meets a cross inside the box, but Bernd Leno wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
4' A free kick to Fulham. Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Tim Robinson is the one to supervise the game today.
